title: Alfred's story of the Saturday night confrontation over 12th Street Rag
summary: Alfred tells how Watts, drunk, taunted him on the bandstand and challenged the band to play 12th Street Rag.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
